help.name: Offcut — a constrained collage worktable
help.description: Invent a work using only existing source pixels. Every fragment is a polygon cut from supplied material. Cuts may not overlap on a source; removed pieces still consume material. Inspect your work with /api/render.png, then revise it.
help.coordinates: Cuts use original source-image pixels. Placement x/y is the center of the cropped fragment on the canvas; rotation is degrees clockwise. Scale is uniform. Piece order is back to front.

actions.title: An original work
actions.statement: What I found in these materials.

restrictions: No generated pixels, color filters, text overlays, arbitrary image URLs, or non-uniform stretching.
No material reuse: two cuts from one source cannot overlap.
Use pieceId on cuts for predictable subsequent references; the response state also includes all piece IDs.

note: Establish the dark moon, printed ground, bridge piers, and a lace observatory.
Assemble a red mullet from five adjacent cuts, sailing across the airship moon.
Raise and narrow the foundation for a full paper margin, then connect the masonry with a bridge deck.
Add two human observers and two drifting shell specimens to give the imagined harbor a human scale.

actions.title: The Tidal Observatory
actions.statement: A red mullet sails over an observatory built from fungal lace and Brooklyn Bridge masonry. An airship’s skin becomes its moon, while shell specimens drift beyond the chart. Two small figures hold the scene at human scale.
